subject: Re: Redwood demo — scheduling / reschedule
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaslogistics.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlaslogistics.com>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed May 15 10:00 AM ET

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for taking a quick call last week — really enjoyed learning about the routing optimization work at Atlas. As discussed, I wanted to get something on the calendar to demo how Redwood can reduce inference latency/cost for your LLM-based routing model.

Proposed: Thursday, May 15 at 10:00 AM ET (30 min) — short demo + Q&A.
If that doesn't work I can do 11:30 AM ET or Friday morning.

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick intros (3 min)
- Live demo: inference latency & cost controls (12 min)
- Integration and deployment options (8 min)
- Next steps / mutual action plan (7 min)

Attaching a one-pager so you have a quick reference.

Attachment: Redwood_OnePager.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaslogistics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlaslogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed May 15 10:00 AM ET

Hi Camila,

Appreciate the follow-up and the one-pager. Unfortunately, we've had a few priorities shift on our side. My director just flagged that the LLM/inference project is being deprioritized this quarter while we focus on integration stability and a major freight-partner rollout.

On top of that, several folks on our side will be traveling the week of the 15th for customer workshops, so May 15 won't work.

Can we park the demo for now and revisit in Q4? If you think a short 20–30 min exec-level intro would still be useful (no engineering deep dive), I'm happy to try to carve out time, but I can't commit to the full demo yet.

Also attaching the RFP doc we circulated internally — it may have useful context if you want to tailor an executive summary.

Attachment: Atlas_RFP.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Product Lead, ML Systems
Atlas Logistics
samir.patel@atlaslogistics.com | +1 646-555-0199

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaslogistics.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlaslogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed May 15 10:00 AM ET

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick note and context. Totally understand shifting priorities and travel constraints.

Proposal:
- We can absolutely pause the full demo until you have bandwidth.
- In the meantime, I can prepare a 20-minute executive summary tailored to the RFP (high-level latency/cost impact, deployment options, and a suggested mutual action plan) and share it with you and Elena. No engineering deep-dive required.

If that sounds useful, I can send proposed 20-min slots for late May / early June — otherwise I'll mark this for Q4 follow-up and check back in August to schedule.

Either way, happy to stay flexible.

Best,
Camila

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 14:45:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo — proposed May 15 10:00 AM ET

Marissa / Avery — forwarding the thread. Quick summary: Atlas (Samir + Elena) just deprioritized the LLM/inference work for this quarter and have travel conflicts. They asked to park the full demo and revisit in Q4, but are open to a 20-min exec-level summary.

Questions / asks:
- Marketing: should I send a tailored one-pager + short slide (exec summary) aligned to the RFP to keep them engaged?
- CS: any objections to marking this as a paused/opportunity and schedule Q4 cadences?
- Sales leadership: can we offer a short exec summary without consuming AE budget/hours — I can run it, but want to coordinate if we should include CS or Solutions SE.

Suggested next step: I can draft the 2-slide exec summary + 1-pager and send to Samir/Elena by end of next week. If you agree, I'll proceed.

Thanks,
Camila

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlaslogistics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@atlaslogistics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed May 15 10:00 AM ET

Hi Camila,

Thanks — that plan sounds reasonable. For now let's pause the full technical demo and schedule a brief exec summary if you think it will help our leadership understand the value quickly. Can you send a short slide + one-pager and I'll circulate internally?

I'll aim to re-open scheduling in Q4 (likely early October) once roadmap priorities settle. If anything changes sooner I will reach out.

Appreciate the flexibility and we'll be in touch.

Best,
Samir
